verdict.rationale: Mercury ships an official, Stainless-generated Go SDK (MercuryTechnologies/mercury-go, v0.13.11). However, the evidence explicitly states there is no official npm or PyPI SDK, so builders in TypeScript or Python must call the REST API directly or use community packages. The generated code samples in the API reference are not SDKs and earn no credit. missing for 10: official TypeScript/JavaScript and Python SDKs, broader multi-language SDK coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of the Go SDK.
